articles.title: Hyperliquid is taking crypto perps deep into DeFi’s ‘money LEGO’ land
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid is capitalizing on the volume and depth of its order book by giving firms the option to compose with the platform’s shared liquidity, rather than fragmenting it.

articles.title: Binance makes fighting crypto crime more difficult, says new report
articles.snippet: The New York Times says a quiet change to Binance's compliance rules is forcing international law enforcement to navigate slow-moving government treaties to get user data.

articles.title: Galaxy, MARA Holdings deepen Texas expansion with land acquisitions
articles.snippet: The crypto-focused companies announced separate acquisitions as demand for power-intensive AI and digital infrastructure continues to grow.

articles.title: Ethereum, Solana led crypto hack losses in H1 2026: Blockaid
articles.snippet: Blockaid found Ethereum remained the hardest-hit blockchain in H1 2026, while Solana replaced Arbitrum as the network with the second-highest losses, driven largely by key compromises.

articles.title: Binance co-founder CZ backs crypto license passporting across ASEAN
articles.snippet: Binance co-founder CZ backed crypto license passporting across ASEAN to simplify approvals, reduce compliance costs and encourage competition.
